item.title: Pitbull set to headline Saudi Arabia Grand Prix
item.description: Pitbull, the renowned American popstar known as 'Mr Worldwide,' is set to headline the Saudi Arabian Grand Prix with a performance on April 18. Joining a star-studded lineup that includes Kygo and Shakira, Pitbull will close the post-qualifying concert. His return to Saudi Arabia follows a previous headline act in Riyadh, promising an electrifying show for F1 ticket holders.
